issue_context.title: Bug: Issue with selection rectangle in the column layout
issue_context.body:
### Description

I'm experiencing a problem when using the column view layout. When I try to select multiple folders, the first one unexpectedly opens. This behavior is not desired because when I'm in a subfolder of the folder I want to select, it closes that subfolder and opens the first selected folder. As a result, when I attempt to select multiple folders, the first one opens and then closes when I select an additional folder.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Switch to the column layout
2. Select multiple folders using the selection rectangle
3. Notice that the first folder that's selected is opened for moment, but then closes after additional folders/items are selected

### Requirements

Delay opening the first folder if selected by the selection rectangle (in the columns layout)

### Files Version

5.5.29.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22621.2283

### Log File

...
